What to Expect When Booking Mobile Detailing

Self-Contained Rigs: Most professional mobile detailers in the Pacific Northwest bring their own filtered water and generators, meaning you don't need to provide an outdoor hose or power outlet.

Space Requirements: They typically just need a relatively flat area—like your driveway or a wide parking space—to set up around your vehicle.
